goal: Review background workers and hosted services for retries, idempotency, graceful shutdown and monitoring.
use: Review background workers and hosted services for retries, idempotency, graceful shutdown and monitoring. Use when a job, queue consumer or scheduled task is added or changed.

steps.note: Read the worker. Open the hosted service or job, its trigger and what it writes.
Check idempotency. A job that may run twice must produce the same result.
Check retries. Retries need a limit, a back-off and a dead-letter path.
Check shutdown. The worker must stop cleanly, finish or return its work, and honour cancellation.
Check monitoring. Each worker needs logs for failures and a metric or alert for backlog and errors.
Report. List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix.
